faqs.question: What does ☮️✨ mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, ☮️✨ punctuates milestone posts — engagements, promotions, baby announcements, exam results. The celebration register is louder than a single 🎉.

faqs.question: Should I send ☮️✨ on a new baby?
faqs.answer: Yes. ☮️✨ is exactly the register for new-baby-coded moments. The combo lands on announcements, photos, and family group chats.

faqs.question: What does ☮️✨ mean to my partner?
faqs.answer: To a partner, ☮️✨ is shared celebration. The combo reads as "look at us" and lands on shared wins.

faqs.question: Is ☮️✨ passive-aggressive?
faqs.answer: No — ☮️✨ is unambiguous in its celebration-coded register. A sender who wants to be passive-aggressive will write the sarcasm separately.
